## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Privacy checks and offline tests pass.
- [ ] The app builds without committed signing credentials.
- [ ] Camera, recognition, local-storage, and message-confirmation safeguards remain intact, or intentional changes are explained.
- [ ] No personal vocabulary, captures, personal emails, credentials, or local home paths are included.

For camera or interaction changes, describe any live testing separately from automated checks.
